# Running your first ProjectOps initiative

## Phase 1. Setup

Define:
- outcome owner
- delivery lead
- change owner
- technical lead

Create:
- project brief
- decision log
- RAID log

## Phase 2. PlanningOps kickoff

- identify scope
- map dependencies
- define cadence

## Phase 3. BuildOps execution

- delivery sync
- backlog refinement
- risk review

## Phase 4. ChangeOps preparation

- stakeholder engagement
- comms and training

## Phase 5. Release

Checklist:
- scope confirmed
- acceptance criteria met
- support ready

## Phase 6. ValueOps follow-up

- measure outcomes
- record lessons

Useful references:
https://www.devops-research.com/research.html
https://www.prosci.com/
